summary: Verified iteration_5 deliverables end-to-end: (1) getDefaultValue precedence regression from iter_4 is FIXED — CT_Milling Metric defaults now show Upper CT OD=50.8 mm, Taper Depth=2440 m, CT Wall=2.77 mm, and Sand_Cleanout shows 2nd Casing ID=139.7 mm / 2nd Casing MD=2477 m. (2) LIVE SIMULATION DIAGRAM section removed from every workbook sheet (verified on Pipe_Stretch, Sand_Cleanout, CT_Milling — body text does not contain 'LIVE SIMULATION DIAGRAM' and no <svg> resides in any simulation-titled section). (3) Team Hub tab bar renders all 5 tabs (chat, inventory, consumables, parts_order, todo) with correct data-testids. (4) Inventory add flow works with location/status, PATCH status LOW persists, DELETE works. (5) Parts_order status enum = REQUESTED/ORDERED/RECEIVED. (6) To-Do form hides Qty/Unit, shows Priority (LOW/MED/HIGH) + Status (OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/DONE). (7) Chat tab still hosts CrewChat with Skipper AI banner + polling. (8) All 14 backend pytest cases for /api/team/items green (list/create/patch/delete + kind validation + auth + cross-team defense).
critical_code_review_comments: workbookData.js getDefaultValue precedence — order now correct: specific compound labels evaluated before generic tokens ('OD','Depth','Casing'). Nice fix.
TeamItemsList.jsx delete uses window.confirm which is jarring on mobile; consider inline confirm chip in a future iteration (non-blocking).

server.py list_team_items returns {items, team_id} but frontend maps data.items — consistent; note however that create_team_item returns the raw doc (not wrapped). Contract inconsistency between list vs create is minor but worth harmonizing.

Cross-team isolation cannot be fully asserted with only the demo cookie (single team). Backend enforces team_id filter in query so isolation should hold — recommend a follow-up e2e once a second seeded user exists.
server.py file has grown past 1000 lines — splitting AI/skipper/team/items modules into routers would improve maintainability.
